<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <!-- Parrot - colorful with curved beak -->
  <defs>
    <style>
      .parrot-green { fill: #66BB6A; }
      .parrot-blue { fill: #42A5F5; }
      .parrot-yellow { fill: #FFEE58; }
      .parrot-red { fill: #EF5350; }
      .parrot-beak { fill: #FFB74D; }
      .eye-white { fill: #FFF; }
      .eye-black { fill: #000; }
      .leg { fill: #757575; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse class="parrot-green" cx="100" cy="115" rx="34" ry="42"/>

  <!-- Chest -->
  <ellipse class="parrot-yellow" cx="100" cy="120" rx="20" ry="28"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle class="parrot-green" cx="100" cy="70" r="24"/>

  <!-- Cheek patch -->
  <circle class="parrot-red" cx="110" cy="75" r="8"/>

  <!-- Eye area -->
  <circle class="eye-white" cx="105" cy="67" r="7"/>
  <circle class="eye-black" cx="106" cy="68" r="4"/>
  <circle cx="107" cy="67" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Beak - curved -->
  <path class="parrot-beak" d="M 118 72 Q 130 70 132 78 Q 128 82 120 80 Z"/>
  <path class="parrot-beak" d="M 118 72 Q 125 68 128 72 Q 125 75 120 74 Z"/>

  <!-- Wing - colorful -->
  <ellipse class="parrot-blue" cx="85" cy="110" rx="14" ry="30" transform="rotate(-20 85 110)"/>
  <path class="parrot-red" d="M 82 100 Q 77 110 82 120" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
  <path class="parrot-yellow" d="M 85 102 Q 80 112 85 122" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Tail - long and colorful -->
  <path class="parrot-blue" d="M 66 120 Q 45 115 35 140 Q 40 150 66 140 Z"/>
  <path class="parrot-green" d="M 60 125 Q 42 122 35 142 Q 38 148 60 140 Z"/>
  <path class="parrot-red" d="M 55 130 L 40 135 L 55 138 Z"/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <line class="leg" x1="95" y1="155" x2="95" y2="170" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line class="leg" x1="105" y1="155" x2="105" y2="170" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- Feet - parrot style -->
  <path class="leg" d="M 95 170 L 90 175 M 95 170 L 100 175 M 95 170 L 95 175" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path class="leg" d="M 105 170 L 100 175 M 105 170 L 110 175 M 105 170 L 105 175" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
</svg>

<svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Large fluffy body -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="135" rx="48" ry="45" fill="#6b5344"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="125" r="25" fill="#6b5344"/>
  <circle cx="120" cy="125" r="25" fill="#6b5344"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="75" r="36" fill="#6b5344"/>

  <!-- Lynx-tipped ears (tufted) -->
  <path d="M 72 48 L 62 20 L 80 45 Z" fill="#6b5344"/>
  <path d="M 128 48 L 138 20 L 120 45 Z" fill="#6b5344"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="20" x2="62" y2="12" stroke="#6b5344" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="138" y1="20" x2="138" y2="12" stroke="#6b5344" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Ruff/mane around neck -->
  <circle cx="90" cy="95" r="18" fill="#8b6954"/>
  <circle cx="110" cy="95" r="18" fill="#8b6954"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="20" fill="#8b6954"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="73" rx="11.83" ry="15.210000000000003" fill="#9acd32"/>
  <ellipse cx="112" cy="73" rx="11.83" ry="15.210000000000003" fill="#9acd32"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="73" rx="3.3800000000000003" ry="11.83" fill="#000"/>
  <ellipse cx="112" cy="73" rx="3.3800000000000003" ry="11.83" fill="#000"/>

  <!-- Strong muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="85" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#8b6954"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M 100 88 L 96 92 L 100 90 L 104 92 Z" fill="#d4a891"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 100 90 Q 95 94 92 92" stroke="#6b5344" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 100 90 Q 105 94 108 92" stroke="#6b5344" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Long whiskers -->
  <line x1="60" y1="80" x2="83" y2="79" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="85" x2="83" y2="83" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="80" x2="117" y2="79" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="85" x2="117" y2="83" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Large paws -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="175" rx="13" ry="15" fill="#6b5344"/>
  <ellipse cx="120" cy="175" rx="13" ry="15" fill="#6b5344"/>

  <!-- Bushy tail -->
  <path d="M 142 135 Q 170 125 182 110" stroke="#6b5344" stroke-width="20" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>

<svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="125" rx="40" ry="42" fill="#d4a574"/>

  <!-- White belly -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="135" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="75" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#d4a574"/>

  <!-- White muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="85" rx="18" ry="20" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Brown spots on head -->
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="68" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#8b4513"/>
  <ellipse cx="115" cy="68" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#8b4513"/>

  <!-- Long ears -->
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="80" rx="17.279999999999998" ry="40.32" fill="#8b4513" transform="rotate(-15 73 80)"/>
  <ellipse cx="127" cy="80" rx="17.279999999999998" ry="40.32" fill="#8b4513" transform="rotate(15 127 80)"/>
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="85" rx="11.52" ry="28.799999999999997" fill="#d4a574" transform="rotate(-15 73 85)"/>
  <ellipse cx="127" cy="85" rx="11.52" ry="28.799999999999997" fill="#d4a574" transform="rotate(15 127 85)"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="92" cy="73" r="8.450000000000001" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="108" cy="73" r="8.450000000000001" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="71" r="3.3800000000000003" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="109" cy="71" r="3.3800000000000003" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="88" r="5" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 100 88 L 98 93 M 100 88 L 102 93" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="78" y="155" width="11" height="30" rx="5" fill="#d4a574"/>
  <rect x="111" y="155" width="11" height="30" rx="5" fill="#d4a574"/>
  <rect x="78" y="170" width="11" height="15" rx="5" fill="#fff"/>
  <rect x="111" y="170" width="11" height="15" rx="5" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Tail (upright) -->
  <path d="M 135 115 Q 148 95 155 85" stroke="#d4a574" stroke-width="11" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="155" cy="82" r="5" fill="#fff"/>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 150">
  <g transform="translate(10, 0)">

  <defs>
    <style>
      .clown-orange { fill: #FF6B35; }
      .clown-white { fill: #FFF; }
      .clown-black { fill: #000; }
      .clown-eye { fill: #FFF; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Body stripes pattern -->
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="75" rx="50" ry="30" class="clown-orange"/>

  <!-- White stripe 1 -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="75" rx="12" ry="32" class="clown-white"/>

  <!-- White stripe 2 -->
  <ellipse cx="95" cy="75" rx="10" ry="32" class="clown-white"/>

  <!-- Black outlines for stripes -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="75" rx="12" ry="32" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="95" cy="75" rx="10" ry="32" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M 135 75 Q 170 60 175 75 Q 170 90 135 80 Z" class="clown-orange" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Top fin -->
  <path d="M 80 50 Q 75 30 90 35 Q 95 45 90 50 Z" class="clown-orange" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Bottom fin -->
  <path d="M 80 100 Q 75 120 90 115 Q 95 105 90 100 Z" class="clown-orange" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="75" r="20" class="clown-orange"/>

  <!-- Eye white -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="70" r="7" class="clown-eye"/>

  <!-- Pupil -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="70" r="3.5" class="clown-black"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 25 82 Q 22 87 28 88" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Body outline -->
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="75" rx="50" ry="30" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  </g>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <title>Orange Ginger Rabbit</title>
  <desc>A cheerful orange-ginger colored rabbit with upright ears</desc>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="135" rx="48" ry="45" fill="#b9651b"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="85" rx="32" ry="35" fill="#b9651b"/>

  <!-- Left ear -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="40" rx="14" ry="38" fill="#b9651b" transform="rotate(-15 82 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="40" rx="7" ry="30" fill="#c47e0e" transform="rotate(-15 82 40)"/>

  <!-- Right ear -->
  <ellipse cx="118" cy="40" rx="14" ry="38" fill="#b9651b" transform="rotate(15 118 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="118" cy="40" rx="7" ry="30" fill="#c47e0e" transform="rotate(15 118 40)"/>

  <!-- Chest patch -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="125" rx="22" ry="28" fill="#c47e0e"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="88" cy="80" r="6" fill="#233240"/>
  <circle cx="112" cy="80" r="6" fill="#233240"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="114" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M 100 92 Q 97 95 95 97 Q 97.5 98 100 97.5 Q 102.5 98 105 97 Q 103 95 100 92" fill="#aa4300"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 100 97.5 Q 95 100 92 102" stroke="#d35400" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 100 97.5 Q 105 100 108 102" stroke="#d35400" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Front paws -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="168" rx="12" ry="16" fill="#b9651b"/>
  <ellipse cx="118" cy="168" rx="12" ry="16" fill="#b9651b"/>

  <!-- Back paw (visible) -->
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="150" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#b9651b"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="135" r="14" fill="#c47e0e"/>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="200" height="200">

  <!-- Ivory sheep with tan face -->

  <circle cx="72" cy="116" r="21" fill="#fafafa"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="111" r="23" fill="#fafafa"/>
  <circle cx="128" cy="116" r="21" fill="#fafafa"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="142" r="19" fill="#fafafa"/>
  <circle cx="122" cy="142" r="19" fill="#fafafa"/>

  <!-- Tan head -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="78" rx="26" ry="29" fill="#d2b48c"/>

  <ellipse cx="82" cy="63" rx="9" ry="16" fill="#c19a6b"/>
  <ellipse cx="118" cy="63" rx="9" ry="16" fill="#c19a6b"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="91" cy="76" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="109" cy="76" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="74" r="2" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="110" cy="74" r="2" fill="#fff"/>

  <rect x="80" y="155" width="11" height="33" rx="5" fill="#d2b48c"/>
  <rect x="109" y="155" width="11" height="33" rx="5" fill="#d2b48c"/>

  <ellipse cx="85.5" cy="186" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#c19a6b"/>

  </g>
</svg>
